decisionConsequence: The responsive audience strongly changes artifacts and preserves creator diversity, but at the balanced objective weight the declared synthetic creators surrender more intent than the predeclared authorship-retention criterion allows. The current product thesis therefore does not earn G0; do not retune the same mechanism after observation in this wave.
boundary: This is a computational tradeoff result inside the declared deterministic audience and synthetic creator models. It does not identify Human authorship, social meaning or enjoyment.
